blocks.text: Mesh Routing is down: the queue holds. Inspectors keep making and signing inspections, and they go out when it's back.
Tablet lost or broken before it syncs: those inspections are lost. Same as losing a clipboard of paper today. We say so up front, not in small print.
Duplicate send: every event carries an id made on the device, and the receiver ignores repeats. Sending twice does no harm.
Airplane-mode test: a device offline for a long stretch, a pile of inspections, then check every one lands in order. Tybalt's bar is a week. Owner TBD.
Balthasar's six-device run, including the old Android 11 tablet.
Friday demo: make an inspection offline, reconnect, watch it sync. That's the end-to-end test Ducal actually sees.
Duplicate sends: send the same event twice on purpose and check the receiver keeps one.
